name: AlN wurtzite, Schulz-Thiemann1977 experimental transcription
citation: H. Schulz and K. H. Thiemann. Crystal structure refinement of AlN and GaN. Solid State Communications23(11) (1977),815–819.
recommendation: experimental publication transcription candidate; native FEFF and numerical validation pending
method: Single-crystal X-ray refinement; lattice parameters determined from25 reflection angles, atomic z from intensity refinement. Isotropic R=.015 and R(w)=.021; Table3 verifies the derived1+3 Al-N shell.
measurement_conditions_evidence: Neither diffraction T/P nor a numerical crystal-growth condition was identified in pp815–819; no ambient conditions inferred. p818 acknowledgements identify Siemens/Philips supply, not conditions.

occupancy.interpretation: Explicit unit occupancies in this derived file encode the published stoichiometric ordered model; no occupancy refinement reported.

license.status: Locally authored transcription of published numeric crystallographic facts with full attribution; not an original publisher CIF and not a COD-licensed artifact.
license.article_rights: Publisher article copyright/licensing remains separate; no PDF or page image included in deliverable.
license.note: No claim that the publisher placed the article or its crystallographic facts under CC0.

notes: The space-group number and unit occupancies are explicit encodings of the published wurtzite stoichiometric model, not separately printed/refined parameters.
Coordinates/cell are experimental and unchanged; no ideal wurtzite u=.375 substitution, cell rescaling or bond equalization.
The isotropic U column is preserved in CIF for fidelity; native FEFF uses average geometry and must not treat these values as a validated EXAFS Debye-Waller factor.
No XAS measurement or experimental EXAFS validation is provided.
